ticket.subject: Search returns nothing for everyone
ticket.body_text:
Hi team,

I look after our account at Saltmarsh Robotics. Global search stopped working for all our users at 11:10 UTC; every query returns zero results.

Clearing caches did not help.

This is blocking us right now, so we need help today. Is this a known incident?

Best,
Jonas

label_notes: clean outage (outage-search-down): a core feature is down for many customers while the rest of the app works, so P2; urgency high: ongoing impact or a deadline within 24 h.
